beginning: Ada climbs the harbour mast at dawn and sends her routine test pulse into the fog.
climax: She decodes the reply and confirms a second mast is answering from across the water.
ending: Ada carries the confirmed signal down the harbour stair to wake the town.
logline: A lone relay keeper finally receives an answer to the test pulse she has sent every dawn for nine years.

scenes.continuity_anchor: fog-bleached steel lattice with oxidized copper cabling, lit only by a low grey dawn
scenes.location: top platform of the harbour relay mast
scenes.purpose: establish the routine vigil and break it with a returning signal

scenes.continuity_anchor: wet basalt steps descending between fog-dulled lamp posts
scenes.location: basalt stair from the mast down to the harbour road
scenes.purpose: commit the answer to the town below

setting: A fog-locked northern harbour that has not seen a sunrise in nine years.
theme: A signal only becomes real once somebody carries it.
title: First Light Signal
turn: The pulse she expects to lose in the fog returns on the same frequency.
